scope: Exposed development comparison on the unchanged V25 jointly randomized scene; no held-out or learned-control claim.
change: When a passing temporary placement has neither clearance nor bounded orientation progress, a geometric final-transfer plan alone no longer admits it. Search up to four actual final-transfer actions from independent copies of that post-buffer state. Only accept the buffer and final leg together if both pass all unchanged physical gates and independent exact motor replay.
unchanged: Original joint sampler and seed, including full yaw and stable alternative orientations
Model geometry, actuator limits, contacts, task destinations and all physical gates
Main scene advances only through recorded motor commands; no qpos/qvel assignment
Clearance and bounded orientation progress remain possible reasons to accept a temporary placement
Every failed planning and physical continuation remains in the evidence
evaluation: Report complete-table success, each final setting, all physical attempts and accepted action sequence against the retained V25 outcome. This change may reduce speculative buffer cycles; it does not prove manipulation feasibility or improve missing grasp families.
stop: At the declared accepted-action budget or exhaustion of current candidates. No failed case becomes an impossibility classification.
